content.text:
Confirmed the full hash: `98322172593acecf02869258c392cc4d08155fb1`.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 98322172593acecf02869258c392cc4d08155fb1

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the history of `src/main/java/maud/Util.java` with `git log -p --follow` looking for when `retargetTrack`/the `if (sourceTrack != null)` guard and the `Validate.nonNull(sourceTrack, ...)` check first appeared, since those are exactly the lines reverted/reworked by the fix commit `7a91a35`.

**(2) The introducing change:** Commit `9832217` (2017-07-07, "clean up javadoc..." refactor) rewrote `retargetTrack` to accept the already-resolved `sourceTrack` as a parameter (instead of looking it up internally), and in `retargetAnimation` it wrapped the call in:
```java
if (sourceTrack != null) {
    BoneTrack track = retargetTrack(...);
    result.addTrack(track);
}
```
and added `Validate.nonNull(sourceTrack, "source track")` inside `retargetTrack`. This meant that whenever a target bone was mapped but had no matching keyframed track in the source animation, no track at all was added for that bone in the retargeted animation.

Before `9832217`, the original `retargetTrack` (introduced in `2b5b203`) always added a track for every mapped bone, but it did so by unconditionally calling `sourceTrack.getTimes()` after `MyAnimation.findTrack(...)`, which would NPE if the source track were null. `9832217`'s change avoided that crash but silently dropped the target bone's track entirely instead of substituting a bind-pose track — an incomplete/incorrect fix that produced the bug fixed by `7a91a35`.

The follow-up commit `fe2ccb8` (2017-07-08) is a large unrelated cleanup that only added an inline comment (`// handle null sourceTrack`) to the same `if` line — no functional change — so it is not the origin of the bug.

**(3) Fix confirms this:** `7a91a35` removes exactly the `if (sourceTrack != null)` skip introduced in `9832217` and the `Validate.nonNull(sourceTrack, ...)` it added, replacing them with logic that always adds a track, generating a single-keyframe bind-pose track when `sourceTrack == null`. This directly undoes the behavior introduced by `9832217`, confirming it as the bug-introducing commit.

I'm fairly confident in this attribution — the fix's changes map one-to-one onto the code added in `98322172`.
